content.text:
Catalog search results now sort the way librarians file them, so "The Hobbit" is listed under H. All 60 tests pass, including the new and updated ones.

The change is in `lib/catalog/search.js`. A leading "The", "A" or "An" is ignored when sorting, and the full title is still shown.

- **Whole words only:** "Anna Karenina" files under A-n-n-a, and "Theory of Games" under T-h-e-o. Only a standalone leading article is skipped.
- **Article-only titles:** a title that is only an article, like "The", keeps its own text as the sort key.
- **Ties:** if two titles file the same, the full title decides the order, so results are stable.
- **Case:** "the hobbit" is treated the same as "The Hobbit".

I updated the existing sort test in `test/catalog.test.js` because the order changed. "The Left Hand of Darkness" now comes before "National Geographic, November 2026". I also added a test covering the cases above.

I didn't commit anything.
